scope: 16 ranks x 3 interior runs x 40 target layer windows; model 49 main stream; fully contained SparseFlashMla only
limitations: Distinct activity ratios and total cycles as exported, not whole-device utilization or exclusive time; ratios may overlap and must not be summed.
Exported per-task counts may omit tasks/engines and cannot establish workload, causal waiting, bandwidth, data identity, runtime numerical path or end-to-end speedup.
Layer groups mix rank/run and model details; comparisons do not establish matching inputs or requests.
No cross-device timestamp comparison; no new device work.
